newsitem.title: USA: Texas Dec jobless rate is its second lowest of '96.
newsitem.headline: Texas Dec jobless rate is its second lowest of '96.

text.p: Texas' unemployment rate fell three-tenths of a percentage point in December to 5.3 percent, the second lowest rate of 1996, the Texas Workforce Commission said this week.
December's seasonally adjusted statewide unemployment rate matched the corresponding U.S. rate for the month.
The number of employed Texans increased by 30,000 in December to 9,246,000.
For the year, October posted the lowest statewide unemployment rate at 5.2 percent.
January and April tied for the year's highest rate at 6.1 percent each.
